title: Upper semicontinuity of the density from the ratio bound (Simon 3.11)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, V a rectifiable n-varifold in ℝ^{n+ℓ} with weight μ = μ_V, and U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open. Assume μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K, and (a) for every ξ ∈ U the quotient μ(B_r(ξ))/(ω_n rⁿ) tends to V.density ξ as r ↓ 0 (V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)); (b) for all η ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and reals R, ρ with B_R(η) ⊆ U and 0 < ρ < R, V.density η ≤ μ(B_ρ(η))/(ω_nρⁿ) (closed balls, μ(·) the real value μ.real). Then Θⁿ(μ_V, ·) = V.density is upper semicontinuous on U.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), IsOpen U → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight → (∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensityAt ξ (V.density ξ)) → (∀ (η : Ambient n ℓ) (R ρ : ℝ), closedBall η R ⊆ U → 0 < ρ → ρ < R → V.density η ≤ V.weight.real (closedBall η ρ) / (omega n * ρ ^ n)) → UpperSemicontinuousOn V.density U
